claims.text: The source defines VQ-VAE: encoder output quantised by nearest-neighbour lookup in embedding table e (R^{KxD}), uniform categorical prior, straight-through gradients with codebook + commitment losses, EMA codebook updates.

Reported numbers: CIFAR-10 bits/dim VAE 4.51 vs VQ-VAE 4.67 vs VIMCO 5.14; ImageNet 128x128x3 to 32x32x1 at K=512; speech 64x/128x downsampling with 49.3% phoneme mapping (128 codes at ~25 Hz) vs 7.2% chance.

limitations.text: No joint prior+VQ-VAE training; uniform prior during representation learning; MSE pixel-loss blur noted in-text.
